To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the nuclear broadening of the quark transverse momentum squared in SIDIS is dominated by the twist-four contribution that is determined by the nuclear quark-gluonic correlation function and the jet transport parameter.
the nuclear enhancement of power corrections is determined by nuclear modification of collinair parton distribution and correlator functions.

the twist-six contributions to $k_\perp$ broadening are determined by the same twist-four collinear parton correlation functions that are responsible for the leading-twist broadening, and that the twist-six power corrections to $k_\top^2$ broadening have no extra nuclear enhancements beyond the twist-four ones.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the transverse momentum of the struck quarks in SIDIS off large nuclei.
the study of transverse momentum broadened in semi-inclusive scattering off large nuclei at the twist-six order.
the study of the higher-twist corrections to the transverse-momentum broadening of the final-state partons in the semi-inclusive deeply-inelastic scattering (SIDIS) on large nuclei.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the transverse momentum distribution of the produced hadrons is a convolution of the twist-four nuclear broadening, which is determined by the jet transport parameter, and twist-six collinear power corrections that are related to the nuclear modification of parton distribution functions.
the twist-six contributions to transverse momentum broadenings in SIDIS off large nuclei are calculable, and they are found to have the same power behavior as those off a free nucleon.

the nuclear modification of the transverse-momentum squared of the struck quarks in semi-inclusive DIS off large nuclei is given by the sum of twist-four and twist-six contributions to all orders of the power corrections $\sim1/Q^2$ in the hard scale $ Q^2$.

nuclear broadening of transverse momentum at the leading twist and the twist-six power corrections are calculable in terms of nuclear parton distribution functions.

The main takeaway from our work is that

a proper treatment of higher-twist corrections is necessary in order to obtain the correct nuclear broadening of the quark transverse momentum distribution in the kinematic region where the jet transport parameter is large.
the transverse momentum distributions of hadrons produced in SIDIS on a large nucleus are sensitive to higher-twist power corrections that have no nuclear enhancement.

the twist-six contributions to transverse momentum broadenings in SIDIS are determined by the same twist-four collinear parton distributions and correlation functions as those in the nuclear modification of unpolarized single inclusive hadron spectra in proton-nucleus collisions.
